label: Community

copy.headline: Believing alone is not the same as believing wrong.
copy.subhead: But it is harder than it has to be. Find your people.
copy.hook: Some of you believe deeply and have absolutely no one around you who does.
copy.body: That is not a character flaw. That is isolation, and isolation makes strong faith feel fragile. We build discipleship community for exactly this. You were never meant to carry it by yourself.
